entry.title: The Wise Man Maduro Lancero
experienceTags: Occasion: Short premium smoke, after a meal, evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Leather, oak, concentrated coffee, dark chocolate, black pepper, caramel, earth and raisin sweetness give this a dense, full-bodied profile with a long sweet finish. The 40 ring keeps the current My Father-made blend concentrated and wrapper-forward while still producing the dense smoke expected from the full lancero. As a pre-cut half it should preserve the Lancero’s intensity and progression while bringing the session down to a practical 3½-inch format.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted exact vitola. The current 7″ × 40 My Father-made Wise Man Maduro Lancero scored 93 points in both Cigar Aficionado (February 2026) and Cigar Insider (November 2025), so Strength and Quality are provisional pending a personal tasting.
productionLines: Made in Nicaragua at My Father Cigars: Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper, Mexican San Andrés binder, and Nicaraguan filler tobaccos grown by the García family.
Purchased as a full lancero and split before lighting into two ~3½″ × 40 half-sessions.
practicalLines: Buy the full Wise Man Maduro Lancero at Cigar Hut for ~A$49 each.
Cut it cleanly in half before lighting: ~A$24.50 per ~3½″ × 40 session.
This keeps the current full-bodied Broadleaf blend inside the catalogue’s practical-session target while preserving the concentrated lancero format.

note: Add the current 7 x 40 My Father-made Foundation The Wise Man Maduro Lancero as an active Half-Cigar entry. Use Cigar Hut's A$49 single as the purchase benchmark, giving A$24.50 per 3.5 x 40 practical half-session. Current blend references identify Connecticut Broadleaf wrapper, Mexican San Andres binder and Nicaraguan filler grown by the Garcia family; do not use the composition of the discontinued older 7.5 x 40 TABSA version. Exact current vitola is rated 93 and full strength by Cigar Aficionado. Append safely to the Half-Cigar ranking, leave Value automatically derived, and leave Flavour unrated until personally tasted.
